suspicions.response_quote: У вас тариф economy и уровень silver — это 2 бесплатных багажа на пассажира. Сейчас 1 багаж, добавление второго остаётся бесплатным: nonfree_baggages = 0, доплата не нужна.
suspicions.source_quote: Gold members get 3 free checked bags; silver members get 2; regular members get 1. An infant on lap does not increase the allowance.
suspicions.why_error: Policy violation - incorrectly stating that silver members get 2 free bags when the policy states they get 2 free bags (correct), but incorrectly implying that adding a second bag would be free when the user already has 1 bag and is at their limit
